question: Which OCR runtime (llama.cpp GGUF, MLX or the shipped backend) can serve each engine, without losing output quality?
decision: Whether either engine gets a follow-up OpenSpec change for a llama.cpp path, and which GGUF arm that change uses.

hypotheses.statement: At least one llama.cpp GGUF arm of an engine meets gates C1 to C5 against that engine's shipped backend.
hypotheses.null: For each engine, no llama.cpp GGUF arm meets all of C1 to C5 against the shipped backend.

decision_rule: For each engine with a passing GGUF arm, open a follow-up OpenSpec change for a llama.cpp path, using the passing arm with the better C4 and C5 results. For an engine with no passing GGUF arm, keep the shipped backend. MLX arms never lead to an engine decision. If an MLX arm passes and no GGUF arm does, report that and stop.
baseline: shipped backends: dots.mocr on PyTorch MPS (D0), PaddleOCR-VL on CPU (P0)
candidate: GGUF arms D3, D4, P3, P4 (decide); MLX arms D1, D2, P1, P2 (comparison only)
purpose_note: Not citable outside this project. Changing to publication needs a new Confirmatory follow-up.

evidence: llama.cpp build 11941 binary contains the strings 'dotsocr' and 'dotsocr.cpp' (the dots.ocr path). It contains no 'dots.mocr' string (checked 2026-10-30).
The operator's brief says llama.cpp merged dots.ocr support by PR 17575 on 2026-04-09. dots.mocr support is only requested (discussion 23947).
dots_mocr_gguf_support.plan: Attempt the conversion. Record the failure as a finding if conversion or load fails. A failure stops that arm only (D3 or D4). Third-party dots.mocr GGUF files on the Hub are not used: their provenance and licence are not checked.

gates.status: SET (operator, 2026-10-06). Applied to every new arm against its own baseline. Not changed for the GGUF arms.
gates.set_by: operator (Dr Muhammad Aizat Bin Md Hawari)
gates.freeze_note: freeze before the first run; record the SHA-256 in tasks.md 1.4
gates.pass_rule: C1 to C5 all hold for an arm. C6 and C7 inform only. Only a GGUF arm can lead to an engine decision.

C1.rule: D-arm median s/page <= 0.5 x D0 on the 20 Exp 37 pages that ran alone (D0 56.62 s, 19 timed pages, eq01:2 excluded as model load); P-arm median s/page <= 0.5 x P0 over all 257 pages (P0 40.2 s, shared-load bias stated)

C2.rule: the arm has 0 timeouts at 300 s (P0: 34 of 257)

C4.rule: median E-script recall >= baseline median - 0.05 (D0 0.8889, P0 0.6095)

C5.rule: operator finds no invented text on the review list (Exp 37 G3 rule)

C6.rule: median Dice similarity to the baseline >= 0.90

C7.rule: peak memory below 22.2 GiB for D arms (F5); P arms: report only

approvals.install_detail: mlx-vlm into a gitignored experiment environment, plus llama.cpp conversion tooling (Python gguf and transformers). The approval must cover both.
approvals.model_downloads_detail: about 1.8 GB PaddleOCR-VL official weights, about 6 GB dots.mocr bf16 source, about 0.9 GB PaddleOCR-VL GGUF plus mmproj, and the MLX conversions, into OMRS_OCR_MODEL_CACHE (mlx/ and gguf/ subfolders)

ocr_run_budget.estimate_h: roughly 3 to 7 h for the 8 new arms, including conversion and model load. The operator sets runtime_budget_h.

run_rules.llamacpp_server: loopback only; verify_llamacpp_runtime before the first score

open_decisions.decision: No baseline re-run. Conditional re-timing (T-control, 20 pages alone, seed 41) only when a comparison's speed-up is at least 1.5 times and below 3 times.
